correctness.rationale: For odd m, the antipodal rung and rim edges admit a bipartition, and the negative-neighbor copying chain gauge-transforms to the voter model; finite voter consensus yields the two absorbing checkerboards with total spin zero under every stationary measure. For even m the graph is non-bipartite, and the finite anti-voter stationary uniqueness and spin-flip symmetry are supplied by Aldous–Fill Proposition 14.19. For distinct sites, stationarity gives 3 C_d+C_(d-1)+C_(d+1)+C_(d+m)=0 with C0=1. The circulant operator A=3I+T+T^-1+T^m is invertible for even m (even Fourier modes >=2; odd modes 2+2cos(pi k/m)>0 when k=m is even). Its odd-frequency Green contribution is (-1)^d(m/8-min(d,2m-d)/4); its even-frequency massive contribution is ((-q)^delta+(-q)^(m-delta))/(4 sqrt3(1-q^m)), q=2-sqrt3. Thus G0=m/8+(1+q^m)/(4sqrt3(1-q^m)); total variance 2m/(6G0)=m/(3G0) has the displayed closed formula, increases along even m and tends to 8/3. Dividing the bounded massive remainder by G0 yields uniform antiperiodic tent correlations; C1,Cm give equal-spin rim/rung limiting counts 4-2/sqrt3,2/sqrt3. Checked independent finite Fourier Green inversions for even m=2..18. The all-size theorem follows from recurrence and Green identities.
